text:
sam: Quick brief — need a compact "bench presspack" for the upcoming webinar. single-slide hero + 3 micro-tiles + 1 one-pager for sales. low-effort, brand-safe. due EOD weds.

tess: Got it. Are we reusing the latency/cost sparkline or do we need fresh data? :eyes:

sam: reuse the sparkline, but make the callout about 'avg token cost' instead of raw latency for this audience. short copy only.

anya: For localization — we need en/us + en/uk + de. Keep copy blocks short so vectors fit. Also confirm we have legal-approved wording for "inference economics" (pinging legal separately).

leo: Design asks: 1) hero: 1200x628 PNG + figma source 2) 3 microtiles: 600x600 each (svg preferred) 3) one-pager: A4 export + editable figma. Deliverable file naming: redwood_bench_-webinar_YYYYMMDD_v1.

leo: Accessibility note — check color contrast on the orange CTA (#FF6A00) over the dark gradient. If contrast <4.5, use white outline or swap to #FF7A3A.

anya: Also need an alternate set with minimal copy for social (no logos, consumable at 1:1).

sam: Here's the copy block for hero and tiles — keep under 90 chars per tile.

```
Hero headline: Serving wins: predictable inference costs for production LLMs
Hero subhead: Optimize batching, caching, and model routing to lower per-token spend.
Tile 1: Faster responses, lower cost — smart batching
Tile 2: Pin models, rollouts, and safe fallbacks
Tile 3: Dedicated pools for consistent throughput
CTA: See benchmarks → (link shortened at handoff)
```

leo: Great. I'll sketch variants tonight. @tess can you prioritize the figma page structure? I'll leave the color decisions and micro-illustration style options in the doc.

tess: Yep — I'll lock layout and export specs. Quick Q: do we want a data viz (sparkline) as an inline overlay on hero or separate microtile? mobile readability concerns.

sam: Separate microtile please. Keep hero clean.

design-bot: deploy:asset-template-v2 applied to thread 1719999999 — auto-export presets queued (png/svg/pdf).

anya: One last constraint — legal asked to avoid using "costless" or absolute claims. Use qualifiers like "lower" or "reduced."

leo: Noted. I'll post first Figma link here when ready for review (ETA tomorrow 10:30am PT). :palette: :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks team — we'll coordinate handoff to sales with the one-pager when approved.

tess: leaving comments on spacing and iconography after 10:30.

sam: Closing note: label all exports with environment (hosted/dedicated/private) where relevant so sales can pick the right slide.

leo: will do.

sam: :rocket:
